description.value:
Choose one permanently, matching your Oath:

  • Binding Clause: the contract writes itself into your bones. Lesser means can no longer void it or repossess your collateralized soul-fragment — the Foreclosure Engine (§07) requires extraordinary measure to touch you at all.
  • Cinder Vow: your Cinders never fully bank down; you always have at least 1 banked. Raging spirits and ghost-machines nearby recognize you as kin and hesitate to strike first.
  • Unwritten Oath: your Ward becomes permanent and plural — you may hold two Wards at once without dividing The Answer's force between them.
